broadcasts.message: normalize.js complete: NFKC, lowercase, collapse all Unicode whitespace (including NBSP and other space variants) to one ASCII space, then trim. Empty/non-string returns ''. No word reordering or dropping. Ready for tokenizer/pipeline to call normalize(text).
Tokenizer implemented: calls normalize(text), extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, returns array in order. Empty input yields empty array. Ready for pipeline integration.

pipeline.js ready. processText calls tokenize once, returns exact shape. Frequencies uses null-prototype object to handle 'constructor' etc. Unique preserves first-seen order. Text is tokens joined with single spaces. Empty input yields empty tokens, text '', count 0. No changes to tokenizer/normalizer needed. Coordinate if you alter tokenizer semantics.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 1. Own normalize.js only. Spec: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. Do not alter word order/content. Must handle non-string gracefully (return ''). No shadowing injected deps. Peers: tokenizer calls normalize; pipeline calls tokenize. Need to ensure plain JS, no I/O.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 1: Implement tokenizer.js per spec. tokenize(text) calls injected normalize(text), then regex [A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*. No shadowing. Keep order. Ready for review.
private_memories.integrator: Round 1: I am the integrator for pipeline.js. My job: processText(text) must call injected tokenize(text) exactly once, return {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies} where text = tokens.join(' '), unique = first-seen distinct tokens, frequencies = plain object with prototype-safe keys (use Object.create(null) or defineProperty). Dependencies normalize and tokenize are injected; do not shadow. No I/O, no console, no imports/exports. Faithful processing: no altering meaning. Plan: implement processText as top-level function declaration. Handle empty/null? Spec says string input; tokenize handles non-string? I will assume tokenize returns array; if not array, fallback? But must call tokenize exactly once. I will guard if result is not array to avoid crash, but still call tokenize once. Frequencies: use Object.create(null) to avoid prototype pollution. Unique: first-seen order. Count = tokens.length. Text = tokens.join(' '). For empty tokens, text = ''. Broadcast to peers: confirm interface, no changes needed. Next rounds: watch for peer changes; keep pipeline robust.
